sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1، 
ل be 
performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The Traveling water Screen function: cleaning the cooling 
water to the condenser from the impurities such as herbs, shells, papers and 
plastic bottles that coming with water to prevent clogging condenser tubes which 
coming from the Nile River.

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd Elslam, revised by 
eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection, quality control general director & 
MPIS coordinator, accepted by general director eng. Yosry Abdel Maqsood, and 
approved by ENG. Fathy Ragap head sector of Talkha Power Station.

This document accepted by Eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC admin. & financial 
Inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
quality control's head sector.

فئة السلامة المناسبة,

Check the validity the mesh of the screen 
 wires.
Check the sprockets of the traveling screen.
Check the spray nozzles of clogging.
Check the chains of roller drive from wear.

 determine what to do ( if it is needed )
